description: This bar chart, titled “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis,” compares the accuracy of three sentiment analysis models—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet.” The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis lists the two categories being compared. Within each category, three bars are displayed side-by-side, corresponding to the three models as indicated by the legend: TEXTBLOB is represented by a white bar with a diagonal hatch pattern, VADER by a white bar with horizontal lines, and ChatGPT by a solid green bar. For the “Emoji Tweets” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.3 for TEXTBLOB, 0.4 for VADER, and 0.6 for ChatGPT. For the “Overall Tweet” category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.4 for TEXTBLOB, 0.4 for VADER, and 0.6 for ChatGPT. The bars are not sorted by height; instead, they are grouped within each category according to the legend. The chart does not visually emphasize any specific bar beyond the standard representation.
